name: TC-54: Verify registration with invalid email format
description: Verify that entering an invalid email format in the 'Реєстрація' modal displays the validation error 'Некоректний формат email' and keeps the 'Зареєструватися' button enabled.
descriptionHtml: Verify that entering an invalid email format in the 'Реєстрація' modal displays the validation error 'Некоректний формат email' and keeps the 'Зареєструватися' button enabled.

testStage.description: Verify that entering an invalid email format in the 'Реєстрація' modal displays the validation error 'Некоректний формат email' and keeps the 'Зареєструватися' button enabled.

steps.name: Step 1 & 2: Open the Registration modal via user menu
Check if Registration modal is displayed
Step 3: Verify that 'Відвідувач' role is selected by default
Step 4: Enter valid data into all fields except Email
Wait for validation error to appear
Get all displayed validation error messages in the form
Get all displayed validation error messages in the form
Get all displayed validation error messages in the form
Step 7: Verify registration button remains enabled
Check if Submit button ('Зареєструватися') is enabled
